A common alternative is a compact action space that lists only in-grid anchors per footprint (225 on 8x8).

This round's candidates match any layout whose length equals n_place. ### Round 3
All 12 trials score 0 on dev and in training. Examples are a chosen landing layer (no drop, K = T·Z) or extra rotations. Every candidate this round builds on a generic K-channel layout hedge, which reduces to the old hedge when K = T.

### Round 4
